checks.review: self-review with Ponytail and ECC security-review; no independent review claimed

limits: In-memory cache retains at most 256 applied commands per process; refuses overflow with ACTUATOR_FAILURE.
Actuator state/cache reset on process restart; no durable exactly-once claim.
Outgoing MQTT queue shared, max 16; actuation without delivered ACK is not confirmation.
No HTTP authorization, trusted PostgreSQL catalog or MQTT/AMQP business gateway implemented.
No durable command_status/timeout; future consumer must validate received_at and refuse late success after terminal timeout.
UTC synchronization still required; second precision does not solve large clock drift.
No physical actuators/sound, full backend/frontend/E2E/load/dependency audit performed.
